source_hash_method: SHA256 of sorted relative path + NUL + file contents for src/**/*.zig, every std file, and build.zig*.
settings: Zig 0.17.0, ReleaseFast/LLVM, embedded std, default caches, seed=0, no disk cache or profiling during acceptance.
protocol: Baseline first in block 0; candidate first in block 1. One warm-up; adaptive 2-3 cold/edit samples and 2-5 runtime samples. Statistics use the median of the two block medians; raw samples and instability flags are retained.
scope: Benchmarks isolate these performance changes from concurrent type/ownership edits in the shared checkout. The benchmark driver and workload are unchanged.

routine_safe.scope: Shared checkout, including concurrent type/ownership changes and this performance implementation. Exit of the existing full build runner was observed; no duplicate full suite was started.

limitations: Several compilation/edit blocks reached the sample cap without 2% repeatability. Eight-worker leaf-edit nonregression is not established by these timings. Native sieve executables are byte-identical; runtime timing differences are environmental.
